preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call EnemyAddress(victim_address, true) to blacklist any target address. This will prevent the victim from making any transfers (buying or selling) since _transfer() checks _isEnemy mapping and reverts if either sender or receiver is blacklisted. The attack demonstrates improper access control where owner can arbitrarily block any address from transacting.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The CoinToken contract has an EnemyAddress function that can only be called by the owner. This function allows the owner to blacklist any address by setting _isEnemy[account] = true. When an address is blacklisted, the _transfer function will revert with 'Enemy address' if either the sender or receiver is in the _isEnemy mapping. This gives the owner arbitrary power to block any address from transacting, which is improper access control and can be abused.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call EnemyAddress to blacklist a victim address, then verify the victim is indeed blacklisted.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the current owner of the target contract
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call EnemyAddress(victim_address, true) on the target contract
4. Verify that _isEnemy[victim_address] returns true
